Here's the checklist — but with a hard stop at 10:00, because running on no sleep is how you end up changing three things at once and breaking your own data. One variable at a time, same rule as always.

Test checklist:
1. Write starting battery level before touching anything
2. Run the route once — note drift direction and cm, mark which segment it failed
3. Pick ONE change (sensor threshold, motor trim, or turn delay — not all three)
4. Run twice with the same change — write both numbers
5. Did it improve? Write yes/no and what you changed
6. If yes: upload the diff, close the laptop
7. If no: write what you ruled out, close the laptop anyway

Eat something real first if you haven't. The route will still need fixing tomorrow if tonight's data is garbage from tunnel-vision fatigue. Set a timer for 9:45 so you're not staring at the serial monitor until the bread burns again.
